title: Puthoff, MK Ultra and the remote viewing programs

tellings.quote: obviously Halutoff was involved in both UFOs side of this as well as the consciousness side of this and of course MK Ultra was maybe the more weaponized version of the consciousness research and remote viewing programs were the more you know tradecraftraft sort of application

plain: A researcher named Matthew Pines, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels, says a scientist named Hal Puthoff worked on both UFOs and research into the human mind. Pines puts it this way: MK Ultra, a secret US programme of mind experiments, was the more weaponised side of that mind research, and remote viewing programmes, which tried to use the mind to see distant places, were the practical spy-craft side, running roughly from the 1950s to the 1990s. If he is right, the same people were studying UFOs and the powers of the mind at once.
